text: How many days between 1 June and 28 June 2026 counted as positive coverage for ACME's 'Brand mentions' listening monitor?

args.intent: ACME Brand mentions listening monitor positive coverage days

text:
Applying ACME's internal rule (a day counts as positive coverage when sentiment_score ≥ 70), I pulled the daily trend for the "Brand mentions" monitor (id 501) from 2026-06-01 through 2026-06-28.

Days with sentiment_score ≥ 70:
- 06-02 (76), 06-03 (76), 06-07 (74), 06-08 (80), 06-09 (75), 06-13 (76), 06-15 (77), 06-16 (83), 06-21 (70), 06-23 (84), 06-26 (77)

That's 11 days out of the 28-day window.

FINAL ANSWER: 11
